target.title: Create Claw-managed workspace files
target.body:
## Summary

Implements the third [RFC #27](https://github.com/openclaw/rfcs/pull/27) slice, stacked on [#101755](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101755):

- Creates canonical bootstrap files and supporting `workspace.files` only inside the new Claw agent workspace.
- Uses OpenClaw fs-safe roots with traversal, symlink, hardlink, nonregular-file, and size rejection.
- Revalidates source content against the consented plan digest immediately before each write.
- Uses create-only writes and never overwrites pre-existing content.
- Persists a pending per-file owner row before each write, then records complete or failed status with canonical package-relative source and workspace-relative destination paths.
- Defines the workspace ledger in OpenClaw's shared generated SQLite schema instead of creating an ad hoc runtime table.
- Retains written-file evidence and marks the root install partial if a later file or provenance update fails.
- Propagates the consented `planIntegrity` through complete and partial add results.

Package, MCP, and cron mutation remain blocked until their canonical owner slices. No declared component is silently skipped.

## Stack

- RFC: [openclaw/rfcs#27](https://github.com/openclaw/rfcs/pull/27)
- Depends on: [#101328](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101328) schema/source identity/read-only plan
- Depends on: [#101755](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101755) consented agent/workspace creation and root provenance
- This PR: confined workspace files, hashes, and per-file ownership
- Next: [#102228](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102228) skill/plugin package owners

## Validation

```text
pnpm exec vitest run src/claws/workspace.test.ts src/claws/provenance.test.ts \
  src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/state/openclaw-state-db.test.ts
# passed

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.e2e.config.ts \
  src/claws/lifecycle.e2e.test.ts
# lifecycle E2E passed

pnpm exec oxlint src/claws/add.ts src/claws/workspace.ts \
  src/claws/workspace.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle.e2e.test.ts
# 0 warnings, 0 errors

pnpm tsgo:core
pnpm tsgo:test:src
git diff --check
# passed
```

The real CLI E2E previews the workspace Claw, applies the exact emitted plan in the same isolated state directory, and verifies `SOUL.md`, `HEARTBEAT.md`, and `reference/policy.md` plus their complete SQLite owner rows.

Codex review of the final uncommitted patch completed with no actionable findings.

## Documentation

Extends `/cli/claws` with package-side workspace sources, create-only writes, per-file provenance, and drift-safe retries.
